splash.offline:
Couldn't reach the Atena server.
Check your connection and try again.
login.microsoft_text: Sign in with your Microsoft account to start playing.
login.offline_text: This is the name other players will see on the server.
login.az_text: Use the same login as the server website.
login.a2f_text: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.nick_short: Your nickname must be at least 3 characters long.
discord.title: Connect your Discord
discord.text: The Atena team uses your Discord to know who you are in game and to release test versions of the modpack.
discord.waiting: Waiting for you to approve in the Discord window...
discord.cancelled: Connection cancelled. Try again whenever you want.
discord.not_configured: Discord verification is not set up yet. Ask the staff.
discord.not_in_guild: You need to be in the Atena Discord server first.
discord.failed: Something went wrong talking to Discord.
discord.banned: Your access to the launcher is blocked.
discord.banned_text: Your access to the Atena launcher was blocked by the staff.
discord.section_text: The account linked to this launcher.
blocked.banned_text: The Atena staff blocked your access to the launcher.
blocked.no_pack_text: There is no modpack released for your account right now. If you think this is a mistake, talk to the staff on Discord.
home.reinstall_text: Download it all again. Worlds are kept.
home.reinstall_confirm: Reinstall the modpack? Mods and configs will be downloaded again. Your worlds and settings are kept.
home.reinstall_done: Ready. Press Install to download the modpack again.
home.players_hidden: The server does not share the name list.
skin.title: Your skin
skin.text: Change your Minecraft skin without leaving the launcher. It talks straight to Mojang, so the skin changes everywhere — not only here.
skin.done: Skin changed. It may take a minute to show up in game.
skin.not_png: That file is not a PNG.
skin.wrong_size: A skin must be 64x64 (or 64x32 for old ones).
skin.expired: Your session expired. Reopen the launcher and try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.accounts_sub: You can keep more than one account saved and switch whenever you want.
settings.ram_text:
How much memory Minecraft is allowed to use. Atena has around 300 mods, so it needs room: 6 GB is the floor, 8 to 10 GB is the sweet spot, and there is no point going past 24 GB.

Do not go over half of your computer's RAM — starving Windows makes the game stutter more than a low limit would.
settings.java_text: The launcher downloads and uses the right Java version on its own (17, for Forge 1.20.1). It is stored in:
settings.java_hint: Only change this if you know what you are doing and want to point to a Java already installed on your PC.
settings.java_bundled: Use the Java that comes with the launcher
settings.java_invalid: The file must be named java or javaw.
settings.res_text: The default is 854 × 480. Most people prefer 1280 × 720 or 1920 × 1080.
settings.downloads_text: How many modpack files are downloaded at the same time during install and updates. Raising it is faster on good connections, but can fail on unstable internet.
settings.appearance_text: In automatic mode the launcher follows your operating system theme.
settings.language_text: The launcher restarts to apply the new language.
settings.backups_text: Before every update the launcher saves a copy of your personal folders. They are stored in:
settings.backups_hint: Older backups are removed automatically — only the most recent ones are kept.
settings.onlaunch_text: What the launcher does after Minecraft starts.
settings.protected_title: Folders the launcher must not touch
settings.protected_text:
The modpack is kept identical to the server: anything that is not part of it gets removed, and files you edited are put back the way the server has them.

List here what you want left alone — one per line. Subfolders work too, like config/create.
settings.protected_hint: Careful: a protected folder stops receiving updates from the server. If the modpack breaks, remove it from this list and reinstall.
home.repair_clean: All {checked} files are intact. Nothing to repair.
home.repair_found: Found {count} damaged file(s) out of {checked}. Press Play to download them again.
home.repair_failed: Couldn't check the files. Try again in a moment.
news.title: Announcements
support.title: Report a problem
support.text: Pack up the logs for the staff.
support.done:
Report saved. Send this file to the staff on Discord:

{file}
support.warn_ram_alta: ⚠ You allocated more than half of your RAM. That starves Windows and makes the game stutter more, not less.
support.warn_ram_baixa: ⚠ Less than 6 GB allocated. Atena has around 300 mods and needs more than that.
support.warn_pc_pouca_ram: ⚠ This PC has less than 8 GB of RAM in total, which is tight for this modpack.
support.warn_disco_cheio: ⚠ Less than 5 GB free on disk. The modpack needs room to update.
settings.support_text: What the launcher sees about this machine. Handy when asking the staff for help.
settings.quickplay_text: Connects straight to Atena when the game opens, skipping the multiplayer menu.
settings.performance_text: Sets the RAM to sensible values for your machine. You can still fine-tune it above.
settings.performance_too_small: This PC does not have enough RAM for that profile.
error.unexpected_text: The launcher hit an error it did not expect. It was written to the log file, and Modpack → Report a problem packages it up for the staff.
error.start_text: The game did not start. The full details are in the log:
home.preparing_hint: The first check on a big modpack can take a few minutes.
home.sync_done: Modpack up to date. {count} file(s) downloaded — press Play when you are ready.
home.sync_partial: {count} file(s) failed to download. Press Update again to retry just those.
home.paused: Paused — press Resume to carry on
extras.title: Optional mods
extras.text: Turn Essential and others on or off.
extras.intro: These only change your own game, never the server. The launcher keeps your choice through every modpack update.
extras.unsupported: not available for this Minecraft version
extras.about_essential: Cosmetics, friends list, screenshot sharing and a nicer main menu. Works on any server.
extras.no_build: {name} has no build for this Minecraft version yet.
extras.checksum: The {name} download did not match the official checksum, so it was thrown away. Try again.
extras.failed: Could not install {name}. Check your connection and try again.
import.title: Import a copy
import.text: Reuse the modpack you already have.
import.intro: Only files that match the server exactly are copied. Anything else is ignored and downloaded normally.
import.nothing: No installation found automatically. Use "Choose a folder" to point at one.
import.done: {count} file(s) came from your disk ({size}). {missing} still missing — press Install or Update to finish.
import.empty: Nothing in that folder matched this modpack. Nothing was copied.
import.same_folder: That is the folder this launcher already uses.
import.no_manifest: Could not read the modpack file list. Check your connection and try again.
home.cancelled: Stopped. Nothing was lost — what already came down stays, and the next try picks up from there.
import.cancelled: Stopped. {count} file(s) were already copied and stay where they are.
fps.title: FPS Boost
fps.intro: Drops the modpack graphics to the minimum. Everything below can be undone with one click — the original values are kept.
fps.not_yet: Open the game once first — Minecraft only writes these settings after it runs.
fps.failed: Could not change the settings. Close the game and try again.
home.playtime_rank: #{position} of {total} in hours played on Atena
home.sync_kept: {count} file(s) you had changed were left alone — your settings stayed as you set them.
notify.pack_text: v{version} is out. Open the launcher and press Update.
notify.launcher_text: v{version} is available. It installs the next time you open the launcher.
